summary.text: Vanessa Enoch is the Democratic nominee challenging incumbent Warren Davidson in Ohio's 8th District. A West Chester, Ohio, management and policy consultant who has also worked as a journalist, television reporter, college professor and dean of students, she is running for the seat for a fifth time after losing the 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024 general elections.

paragraphs.text: Born in Cincinnati, Ohio, and lives in West Chester, Ohio; graduated from Northwest High School.

Earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Ohio State University (1992), an MBA from Xavier University (1999), and a doctorate in public policy from Union Institute & University (2017). In a Candidate Connection survey she describes herself as a first-generation college graduate.
Has worked as a journalist, television reporter, college professor, and dean of students.

Is president and CEO of Cultural Impact, LLC, a management and technology consulting firm; in her 2024 Candidate Connection survey she says she has run it for over 20 years and has lived and worked overseas.

Serves as board president of Vision Works, Inc. and has held board roles with the Black Greeks Speak-Social Justice Organization and Joseph Dream, a race reconciliation and healing organization; also lists membership in the American Society for Public Administrators in Cincinnati, the American Political Science Association, and the National Black MBA Association's Cincinnati chapter.
Was the Democratic nominee against Davidson in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, and won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary with 74.5% of the vote over Madaris Grant.
